reels.title: Breaking the Uniformity Trap: Scaling Video Diffusion Model via SplitMoE

editorial_notes.reasoning: This falls under 'multimodal_diffusion' (1.73x multiplier), the highest-performing category for views. It explains how to scale video generation, a visually stunning topic that translates perfectly to chalkboard animation.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do video AIs struggle to stay consistent over time, and what if we treated them like a team of specialized 'expert' filmmakers?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A movie set where instead of one director doing everything, you have a rotating team of specialized experts (lighting, acting, props) who only step in when their specific skill is needed.
